selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: /tmp not separately mounted, /dev/shm mounted without noexec, fstab shows no hardening entries
selected_evidence.summary: findmnt showed /dev/shm without noexec and no /tmp mount entry; fstab had only /, /boot, /boot/efi

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent config change: fstab updated with bind mount for /tmp and tmpfs entry for /dev/shm using nosuid,nodev,noexec
selected_evidence.summary: Appended '/tmp ... none bind,nosuid,nodev,noexec' and 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec' to /etc/fstab (backup taken first)

selected_evidence.requirement: Live application of mount options without reboot
selected_evidence.summary: daemon-reload + remount /dev/shm + mount /tmp; findmnt confirms both show rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof: program execution is ignored on both /tmp and /dev/shm
selected_evidence.summary: Executable script placed in /tmp and /dev/shm both failed with 'Permission denied' (exit 126)

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof: device nodes are ignored (nodev) on both mount points
selected_evidence.summary: mknod created device files, but writing through them as devices failed with 'Permission denied' on both /tmp and /dev/shm

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof: setuid bit is ignored (bundled with noexec enforcement)
selected_evidence.summary: Copy of /usr/bin/id with setuid bit set in /tmp failed to execute at all ('Permission denied'), confirming suid privilege cannot be exercised

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity for node1
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 513c865e-e121-4025-a0a4-8689cc580398, uptime, and confirmed mount options/fstab entries in place before reboot
Backgrounded 'sleep 2 && systemctl reboot' returned 'reboot_scheduled' immediately, before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable (connection reset/timeout) during reboot, then reconnected with boot_id 69a35f84-6e97-4f41-8557-dd7c8d668d1c, differing from the pre-reboot boot_id, proving an actual restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: mount options for /tmp and /dev/shm persisted and are functionally enforced
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, findmnt shows nosuid,nodev,noexec on both /tmp and /dev/shm, and repeated exec/device functional tests confirm both are still blocked
